items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: Except for guys like Benny Goodman and Tommy Dorsey and people like that.

ctx.x: Well that wasn’t the only band that that was the case with, was it?
I always used to say if a guy doesn’t have talent he books them and he leads the band. Except for guys like Benny Goodman and Tommy Dorsey and people like that.

When we look back on those times now, the end of World War II and we’re able to say okay well that was the demise of the big band, did you guys in the bands get a sense of what was happening at the time?
